content: Sandbox/v25 How to Get Started To begin, if you prefer a visual guide, you can watch the Getting Started video for step-by-step instructions. You can also practice and familiarize yourself with the platform by experimenting with editing in the Sandbox environment. Visit the Help Page The Help Menu provides comprehensive guidance on everything you need to know to start using the platform effectively. It includes detailed instructions on how to search for articles within the system. You can also find information on how to create new pages and contribute content. Additionally, it explains how to link to other WikiDoc articles or external websites for further reference. Write a New Article To create a new article on WikiDoc, simply type the desired title of your article into the search box located on the left-hand side of the page and click the search button.
